PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION
  FINANCE COMMITTEE MINUTES
  THURSDAY, APRIL 24, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, Chair
Robert Shannon, Member

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 9:00 AM, Chair Scott called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Shannon, Scott

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55059  Recommendation to approve March 13, 2025 Finance Committee meeting
  minutes.

  A motion was made by Chair Scott, seconded by Member Shannon, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Shannon, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

2.  25-55061  Recommendation to receive and file the Fiscal Year 2025 Mid-Year Outlook and
  Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Preview.

  A motion was made by Member Shannon, seconded by Chair Scott, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2 Shannon, Scott
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None

  Absent: 0 None

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, introduced Agenda Item
  2, which provided a mid-year snapshot of the budget and preliminary planning
  outlook for Fiscal Year 2026. He then invited Stefanie Clavery, Acting Senior
  Director of Finance, Utilities Department, to present the staff report.

  Daniel Gutierrez, Manager of Budget and Rates, Utilities Department, presented the
  FY 2026 Water Fund projections, cost pressures, and CIP/debt impact.

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, spoke.

  Chair Scott spoke.

  Member Shannon spoke.

  Chair Scott spoke.

  A dialogue ensued between Member Shannon and Anatole Falagan, General
  Manager, Utilities Department.

  Chair Scott spoke.

  Stefanie Clavery, Acting Senior Director of Finance, Utilities Department, spoke.

  Chair Scott spoke.

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, spoke.

  Chair Scott spoke.

PUBLIC COMMENT

There were no comments received from the public.
